name: Intestinal epithelial homeostasis and defensin-mediated antimicrobial defense
rationale: Members combine intestinal epithelial development, stem-cell and barrier maintenance with defensins, microbiota shaping and anti-nematode/chitin defense; confusables have antimicrobial peptides but lack the intestinal epithelial maintenance members.

name: EGFR and ERBB2 signaling through SHC1 and GRB2 adaptors
rationale: Members are EGFR-family signaling events, mostly SHC1/GRB2 adaptor recruitment by EGFR/ERBB2 plus EGFR transactivation and inhibition; confusables instead carry ERBB3/ERBB4, PI3K, PLCG1, GRB7 and PTK6 branches.

qualifier: promoter clearance, pausing and elongation entry
name: RNA polymerase II promoter clearance, pausing and elongation entry
rationale: All members concern the cellular Pol II transition from promoter clearance through pausing to elongation-complex formation; confusables cover initiation/promoter escape or HIV-specific elongation.

name: Resting B lymphocyte identity and surface marker signatures
rationale: Most members are B, naive B and plasma cell surface or identity signatures (with a few lymphocyte marker sets such as butyrophilins); confusables add B/T cell activation, BCR signaling and development or germinal-center switching.

name: NGF–TRKA signaling via PLC-gamma1, STAT3 and retrograde transport
rationale: All members are NGF/TRKA signaling outputs, specifically PLC-gamma1, STAT3 and retrograde signaling; confusables hold other NGF branches (FRS2, ARMS, ERK5, CREB, p75NTR) or NTRK3.

qualifier: with lysophospholipid hydrolysis and sphingolipid synthesis
name: Intermembrane phospho- and sphingolipid transfer and lysophospholipid hydrolysis
rationale: Members are non-vesicular transfer of glycolipids, ceramide-1-phosphate and PI/PC plus lysophospholipid (LPC/LPE) hydrolysis and PI/sphingomyelin synthesis; confusables lack the lysophospholipid catabolism or are bulk phospholipid biosynthesis.

qualifier: glycosyltransferase defects in glycan assembly and processing
name: Glycosyltransferase-defect congenital disorders of N-glycan assembly
rationale: All members are CDG caused by defective ALG/DPAGT1/RFT1 lipid-linked oligosaccharide assembly or MGAT2/B4GALT1 Golgi processing; confusables are CDG of mannose-donor supply (PMM2, MPI, DPM, DOLK).

name: Interferon-gamma signaling, its regulation and MHC induction
rationale: All members concern type II interferon signaling, its positive/negative regulation and MHC class I/II induction; confusables are type I/III interferon or IL-12/Th1 differentiation.

qualifier: sphingoid base and sphingomyelin, not glycosphingolipids
name: Sphingoid base and sphingomyelin synthesis and catabolism
rationale: Members are de novo sphingoid/ceramide and sphingomyelin synthesis and sphingolipid catabolism; confusables cover glycosphingolipids/gangliosides, ceramide regulation or very-long-chain fatty acids.

qualifier: at excitatory and inhibitory synapses via neuroligins
name: Neuroligin-driven postsynaptic receptor clustering at excitatory and inhibitory synapses
rationale: Members concern postsynaptic assembly, NMDA/GABA receptor, PSD-95 and gephyrin clustering, neurexin-neuroligin and EPSP/IPSP regulation; confusables emphasise presynaptic assembly and adhesion molecules and lack inhibitory synapse members.

qualifier: via ghrelin, somatostatin and glucagon-family GPCRs
name: Feeding behavior and pituitary secretion regulated by peptide-hormone GPCRs
rationale: Members combine eating behavior and nutrient responses with growth hormone/prolactin secretion via ghrelin, somatostatin, glucagon-type and relaxin receptors; confusables center on leptin, calcitonin/amylin or free fatty acid receptors.

qualifier: with positive glutamatergic and GABAergic transmission
name: Exploration and grooming behavior with positive glutamatergic and GABAergic transmission
rationale: Members are locomotor, exploratory, grooming and psychomotor behaviors, amygdala development and positive regulation of glutamatergic/GABAergic transmission; confusables lack the transmission enhancement or amygdala/grooming members.

name: Glutathione cycle and glutathione-dependent redox and dicarbonyl detoxification
rationale: Members are glutathione synthesis, recycling, transport and its inherited defects, plus ROS, aldehyde and methylglyoxal detoxification and NADPH regeneration; confusables cover transsulfuration/selenium, ascorbate/NADP, alkylation repair or ferroptosis promotion.

name: Leukotriene B4 and lipoxin formation and omega-oxidative inactivation
rationale: Members are 5-lipoxygenase products (5-HETE, LTB4, lipoxins) and their omega-oxidative catabolism; confusables cover cysteinyl leukotrienes, 12/15-HETE, hepoxilins or specialized pro-resolving mediators.

qualifier: BAF remodeling complexes and protein acetylation
name: BAF chromatin remodeling complexes and protein lysine acetylation
rationale: Members are assembly of BAF/SWI-SNF variants and CHD1/2 remodelers together with histone and non-histone protein acetylation; confusables center on histone methylation or nucleosome assembly.

qualifier: receptor internalization, pinocytosis and caveolar routes
name: Regulation of receptor internalization, pinocytosis and caveolar endocytosis
rationale: Members regulate entry into the cell (receptor/GPCR internalization, pinocytosis, caveolin and clathrin cargo, raft assembly, early endosome sorting); confusables emphasise recycling or lysosomal receptor degradation.

name: RB1–E2F G1/S checkpoint and its disruption by RB1 mutants
rationale: Members concern RB1 binding of E2F at the G1/S checkpoint, Cyclin E:CDK2 phosphorylation and defective RB1 mutants; confusables are E2F target transcription and G2/M checkpoint programs.

name: Placental trophoblast differentiation, labyrinth morphogenesis and decidualization
rationale: All members concern placenta formation: trophoblast and giant-cell differentiation, endoreduplication, chorio-allantoic fusion, labyrinth vasculature and decidualization; confusables are ovarian/progesterone, trophoblast migration or early lineage specification.

name: Renin-angiotensin and renal regulation of systemic blood pressure
rationale: Members are angiotensin, vasopressin, endothelin, kinin and renal mechanisms of blood pressure and volume; confusables center on NO-cGMP smooth-muscle relaxation or vasopressin water handling.

name: Phosphate and vitamin D homeostasis controlling bone and tooth mineralization
rationale: Members are Na/Pi transport and its disorders, vitamin D metabolism defects, FGF23-Klotho and PTH response, and bone, enamel and dentin mineralization; confusables are vitamin K carboxylation or odontogenesis/chondrocyte development without the phosphate-vitamin D axis.

name: Embryonic eye morphogenesis of lens, cornea, iris and optic cup
rationale: Members are camera-type eye structural development (lens fibers and transparency, cornea, iris, eyelid, optic cup, pigmentation); confusables cover retinal neuron/photoreceptor differentiation, optic nerve or post-embryonic remodeling.

qualifier: female meiosis I cohesion, alignment and checkpoint control
name: Female meiosis I chromosome cohesion, alignment and segregation control
rationale: Members concern meiosis I chromosome segregation: cohesion, chiasmata, spindle, alignment, checkpoint and metaphase/anaphase restraint; confusables cover recombination/synapsis, male meiosis or G2/MI resumption.

name: Neural plate formation, regionalization and border specification
rationale: Members concern anterior/posterior neural plate formation, regionalization, border and neural fold, with early body-axis determination; confusables are axial mesoderm/notochord or hindbrain HOX and neural crest commitment.

name: Aggresome formation and aggrephagy of misfolded proteins
rationale: Members concern misfolded protein oligomerization, perinuclear aggresome assembly and its autophagic clearance; confusables are chaperone-mediated autophagy, ERAD or stress granules.

name: Cardiac conduction system depolarization and gap junction electrical coupling
rationale: Members concern depolarization in SA/AV node, His-Purkinje and myocytes, HCN channels and gap-junction coupling; confusables cover repolarization potassium currents or conduction-system development.
